how_to_apply: Nashik Kotwal Apply Online process is conducted through the official recruitment portal https://nashik.kotwal.org/Kotwal/Home/Home.
Click on "Apply Online" or "Application Form" and read the downloadable manifesto/official declaration (advertisement) carefully before proceeding.
Fill in all the information in the online application accurately and in English.
Upload your photo and signature in JPG/PNG format; upload your caste certificate, school leaving certificate, and residence certificate in PDF format (maximum 200 KB each).
Pay the applicable exam fee online. If the amount is deducted but the application is not confirmed, wait at least 24 hours before attempting payment again - do not make a double payment immediately.
After successful submission of the application, retain a printed copy using the 'Reprint Application' option available on the website.
Submit the completed application between 03.10.2026 and 17.10.2026.
Download the Admit Card for the written examination from the official website once it is made available, before the examination date.
important_instructions: The application must be filled in accurately and entirely in English. Photo and signature must be uploaded in JPG/PNG format; caste certificate, school leaving certificate, and residence certificate must be uploaded in PDF format, each not exceeding 200 KB. If the exam fee amount is deducted from the bank account after online payment but confirmation is not received, candidates should wait at least 24 hours and avoid making a double payment immediately. A printed copy of the application should be retained using the 'Reprint Application' option after successful submission. The Admit Card for the written examination will be made available on the official website before the examination date. Candidates should note that only candidates who are local residents of the respective village/saja applied for are eligible, so the application must be submitted for the correct taluka/jurisdiction. The recruitment process is being implemented transparently and in accordance with the rules; candidates should not fall prey to any unauthorized person or malpractice. For any problems related to the recruitment process, candidates may contact the helpline.

content_sections.heading: Nashik Kotwal Vacancy 2026 – Taluka-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 156 Kotwal posts are vacant across 15 talukas of Nashik district. Some talukas - Surgana, Trimbakeshwar, Peth, and Kalvan - are marked 100%, indicating these vacancies are reserved in full for the applicable reserved category as per the taluka-wise reservation roster.

content_sections.heading: Nashik Kotwal Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The candidate must have passed at least 4th standard (mark sheet from 4th to 9th standard, or a school leaving certificate, is required as proof). It is mandatory for the candidate to be a local resident of the respective village/saja for which he/she is applying. The candidate should be physically fit and able; a certificate from a competent medical officer will be required.

content_sections.text: The applicant's age should be between 18 and 40 years . As per the Government decision, candidates from the reserved category will be given relaxation in the age limit as per the rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Collector's Office, Nashik, Government of Maharashtra, to fill 156 vacant Kotwal (Mahsul Sevak) posts across 15 talukas of Nashik district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 156 vacancies are available across 15 talukas, with Baglan (26), Nashik (16), Dindori (16), Kalvan (14), and Malegaon (14) having the highest number of posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 17.10.2026. Online applications commenced on 03.10.2026, following the advertisement published on 02.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Nashik Kotwal?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least 4th standard, supported by a mark sheet from 4th to 9th standard or a school leaving certificate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 40 years. Candidates from the reserved category will be given age relaxation as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is local residence required for Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, it is mandatory for the candidate to be a local resident of the respective village/saja for which they are applying.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must visit https://nashik.kotwal.org/Kotwal/Home/Home, fill the online application accurately in English, upload the required documents and photo/signature, pay the exam fee online, and submit the application between 03.10.2026 and 17.10.2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for Nashik Kotwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to upload a photo and signature in JPG/PNG format, and a caste certificate, school leaving certificate, and residence certificate in PDF format (maximum 200 KB each).
